title: Example Analysis
text:
Bootstrap Means
Seed every random draw, so that each render gives the same numbers and the same figures.

set.seed(2026)
boot_means <- replicate(200, mean(sample(dat$score, replace = TRUE)))
hist(boot_means, main = "Bootstrap means of score", xlab = "Mean score")

title: Supplemental Materials
text:
ImportantBefore your first commit



Run quarto render once in this folder. The first render adds the template’s rules to .gitignore, which keep fitted models and other large files out of git. It also writes README.md, the page for the site’s readers, unless a README.md already exists. The guide for authors is GUIDE.md.
Put the paper title, citation, DOIs, and data files in _supplement.yml. This page reads them from there. Then delete this box.
This site hosts the supplemental analysis reports, code, and data for:

title: Supplemental Materials
text:
Archived Version
A frozen, citable copy of these materials is archived on Zenodo. The DOI badge and the download link show here after you add the values under zenodo in _supplement.yml.
